column1: # European Portuguese MANUAL correction supplement — hand-curated, merged OVER the wikipron-generated
# lexicon.tsv (manual wins). Fills the open-mid-vowel coverage class the adjudicated micro-gold exposed:
# high-frequency words that wikipron either lacks (telefone, nove, fome) or transcribes with the wrong
# quality (bola → wikipron close o, but EP is open ɔ). Same format: word<TAB>ɛ|ɔ (stressed mid vowel opens).
